description: Terms no authored text may contain (BUILD_PROMPT.md section 3.3). A tripwire, not a censor: the policy is kept by authoring, and this catches careless edits. Each pattern is matched case-insensitively as a whole word. Read by tools/validate-content and by the taxonomy tests in :core:data, so there is exactly one list.

groups.reason: Anyone under 18, or any age-ambiguous framing
Non-consent, coercion, or acts on someone unable to agree
Intoxication, or anything requiring a substance
Harm, or anything needing safety knowledge the app cannot supply
Third parties or anyone outside the couple
Explicit description: the product works in suggestion, not anatomy (section 3.6)
